check_box.label: Enable sun and moon lens flares
check_box.name: render_lens_flares
check_box.tool_tip: Renders screen-space camera flares for visible, unoccluded sun and moon sources. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Lens flare strength
slider.name: lens_flare_strength
slider.tool_tip: Controls the overall intensity of sun and moon lens flare ghosts. Zero hides them.

button.name: reset_lens_flare_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset lens flare strength to its default value

slider.label: Lens flare saturation
slider.name: lens_flare_saturation
slider.tool_tip: At zero, ghosts use only the current source-light color. At one, they retain their full aperture colors.

button.name: reset_lens_flare_saturation
button.tool_tip: Reset lens flare saturation to its default value

check_box.label: Enable vignette
check_box.name: render_vignette
check_box.tool_tip: Darkens the outer camera image. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: vignette_strength
slider.tool_tip: Controls maximum outer darkness. Zero has the same visual result as disabling the vignette.

button.name: reset_vignette_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset vignette strength to its default value

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: vignette_radius
slider.tool_tip: At one, the circular vignette diameter equals the shorter screen dimension. Zero darkens the entire image.

button.name: reset_vignette_radius
button.tool_tip: Reset vignette radius to its default value

slider.label: Smoothness
slider.name: vignette_smoothness
slider.tool_tip: Zero creates a hard edge. One fades gradually from the center to the outer darkness.

button.name: reset_vignette_smoothness
button.tool_tip: Reset vignette smoothness to its default value

slider.label: Shape
slider.name: vignette_shape
slider.tool_tip: Zero is circular; negative values make a horizontal ellipse and positive values make a vertical ellipse.

button.name: reset_vignette_shape
button.tool_tip: Reset vignette shape to its default value

check_box.label: Enable chromatic aberration
check_box.name: render_chromatic_aberration
check_box.tool_tip: Separates red and blue toward image edges. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: chromatic_aberration_strength
slider.tool_tip: Channel displacement at the corners, measured in pixels at a 1080-pixel short edge. Zero disables the pass.

button.name: reset_chromatic_aberration_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset strength to its default value

slider.label: Falloff
slider.name: chromatic_aberration_falloff
slider.tool_tip: Higher values concentrate color separation near the corners. Very low values make separation nearly uniform across the image.

button.name: reset_chromatic_aberration_falloff
button.tool_tip: Reset falloff to its default value

slider.label: Center X
slider.name: chromatic_aberration_center_x
slider.tool_tip: Horizontal position of the aberration center. 0.5 is screen center.

button.name: reset_chromatic_aberration_center_x
button.tool_tip: Reset center X to its default value

slider.label: Center Y
slider.name: chromatic_aberration_center_y
slider.tool_tip: Vertical position of the aberration center. 0.5 is screen center.

button.name: reset_chromatic_aberration_center_y
button.tool_tip: Reset center Y to its default value

check_box.label: Show center beacon
check_box.name: chromatic_aberration_show_beacon
check_box.tool_tip: Draws a crosshair marker at the chromatic aberration center.

check_box.label: Enable bright-surface bloom
check_box.name: render_diffuse_glow
check_box.tool_tip: Adds soft glow around visually bright parts of the completed scene. Requires the viewer's Render glow setting. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Brightness threshold
slider.name: diffuse_glow_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Sets which surfaces bloom. Higher values restrict the effect to brighter pixels.

button.name: reset_diffuse_glow_threshold
button.tool_tip: Reset brightness threshold to its default value

slider.label: Softness
slider.name: diffuse_glow_softness
slider.tool_tip: Controls how gradually bloom begins around the brightness threshold. Zero creates a hard cutoff.

button.name: reset_diffuse_glow_softness
button.tool_tip: Reset bloom softness to its default value

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: diffuse_glow_strength
slider.tool_tip: Controls how strongly bright surfaces feed the glow effect. Zero removes bright-surface bloom without affecting authored material glow.

button.name: reset_diffuse_glow_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset bloom strength to its default value
